Name: Move
Text: Move with W A S D. Look with the mouse. Jump with Space.

Name: Use
Text: Look at something and press {Use} to use it or talk.

Name: Journal
Text: What to do next is always at the top right. {Pack} opens your satchel: pack, journal, notes and settings.

Name: Sprint
Text: Hold {Sprint} to run. Running spends Stamina, the green bar.

Name: Harvest
Text: Pigment grows here. Press {Use} to harvest it.

Name: Wet
Text: Fresh pigment is wet. Rest at a lit Lampstand to dry it: only dry pigment is safe, and only dry pigment can be spent on yourself.

Name: Craft
Text: A station turns pigment and materials into things. Press {Use}, then choose a recipe.

Name: DarkLamp
Text: This Lampstand has gone out. Lamp Oil lights it: press {Use}.

Name: Rest
Text: A lit Lampstand is a place to rest. Resting heals you, dries your pigment, saves, and opens your palette.

Name: Stroke
Text: {Pigment} is in your palette. Hold {HeavyAttack} for its Stroke, {Stroke}. Tap for a plain heavy attack.

Name: Glim
Text: Strokes cost Glim, the light in your lantern (the orange bar), wherever the world is dark. Here a Stroke costs {Cost}. In full light they are free.

Name: Fight
Text: {LightAttack} light attack. {HeavyAttack} heavy. {Dodge} dodge. The glow and the mark on the ground show where a hit will land, and when.

Name: Dodge
Text: Dodge through an attack just before it lands and it passes through you. A late dodge gives Glim back.

Name: LockOn
Text: {LockOn} locks your view onto an enemy. Press it again to let go.

Name: Contrast
Text: Every creature has a colour. Its opposite hurts it more. {Enemy} is weak to {Weakness}.

Name: Stagger
Text: Hits fill the thin bar under an enemy's health. Fill it and the enemy is helpless for a moment: use a heavy attack or a Stroke.

Name: GlimBack
Text: Low on Glim. It comes back when you finish an enemy, dodge at the last moment, pour Lamp Oil ({LampOil}) or rest.

Name: Poultice
Text: {Poultice} uses a Moss Poultice. Resting tops you up to two.

Name: Wells
Text: You have two palette wells. {SwapWell} swaps between them.

Name: Flare
Text: There is no light here. {Flare} lights a Flare for 8 seconds: sketched things are solid while it burns, and hidden writing shows.

Name: Canvas
Text: Pale cross-hatched canvas is unpainted. Nothing was ever put there. You can walk through it.

Name: Death
Text: You wake where you last rested or arrived. From now on, dying costs half your wet pigment. Dry pigment is safe.
